title: Bound term-basis shears on the P104 frame-pair decoder
body:
## Result

This adds a source-pinned, exact finite screen of term-basis changes on PR717's P104 eight-term decoder.

- All 392 one-shear support classes across the 56 ordered term pairs have six rank-7 and two rank-8 terms, so `cst=58` instead of the original 56.
- The bounded 71,344 touching two-shear paths have cost histogram `{56:336, 58:2744, 59:32928, 60:35336}` and no `cst=57` cases. Every `cst=56` path is an inverse move on the same ordered pair and restores the original factorization.
- Exact rank-profile dynamic programming allows any eight term ranks in `0..9`, including a zero term. At the 5% ceiling target, the best possible moment lower bound is `1.00012336...` for `cst=57`, so all larger totals fail before delivery, restoration, hosting or precision costs.

This is a bounded negative result for one elementary shear and the stated touching two-shear alphabet. It is not a physical supplier, new κ, selected-result change or universal obstruction.
